name: warrant
description: Verifiable authority and accountability infrastructure for AI agents — technical demonstrator

scripts.build:api: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @warrant/api
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:verifier && npm run build -w @warrant/api && npm run build -w @warrant/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:core && npm run dev -w @warrant/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:api && npm run start -w @warrant/api
scripts.conformance: npm run build:verifier --silent && node packages/verifier/dist/cli.js conformance ./conformance
